description: This circular walk explores the delightful Arger Fen Nature Reserve near Levenheath in Suffolk. The reserve has some peaceful woodland trails with bluebells in the spring and lots of wildlife to see. Along the way there's also some fine views of the surrounding countryside of the Dedham Vale Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty. The area is located close to the Bures River Walk where you can also enjoy a climb to the Bures Dragon viewpoint.
